privacy: Codes describe bounded local operational state only; do not attach raw learner/process values.

events.human: A JavaScript runtime error occurred. Capture the safe diagnostic snapshot and reproduce before changing data.
An asynchronous operation rejected without a handled recovery path. Preserve the safe code/context and investigate the owning workflow.
A same-origin runtime resource did not load successfully. Verify deployment/cache coherence before retrying.
Network connectivity is unavailable. Offline-capable flows may continue; external/deployment checks are deferred.
Connectivity returned and deployment coherence can be checked again.
A service-worker update was detected and is progressing through the governed update lifecycle.
A service-worker candidate reached installed state; activation/control still follows browser lifecycle rules.
A service worker became redundant unexpectedly. Verify active controller/cache/release coherence before promotion.
The active service-worker controller changed; re-check release/cache identity when diagnosing update problems.
Deployment metadata, manifest and service-worker revision are coherent for the checked public runtime.
Public deployment metadata or service-worker identity disagrees. Stop promotion and restore a coherent exact artifact.
Deployment coherence could not be checked because required public files were unreachable.
Software-controlled checks may be healthy, but genuine human/device/platform evidence is still required. This is not a stuck runtime.
A canonical lifecycle binding is missing, contradictory or outside an allowed transition. Repair the governed state rather than relabelling it.
